headline: Injected 12 canaries across 62 items; caught 5. Median review time 15.2s on canaries vs 14.5s on real items.
flags: Flatness flag for blake: median under 8s across at least 3 decisions, or CV under 0.25 with median under 15s across at least 5 decisions.
Flatness flag for casey: median under 8s across at least 3 decisions, or CV under 0.25 with median under 15s across at least 5 decisions.

recommendation: Require blake to explain the diff in one sentence before every approval until the flatness rule clears: median at least 8 seconds, and, once they have 5 or more decisions, either a coefficient of variation of at least 0.25 or a median of at least 15 seconds.
limits: Limits: small sample; demonstrates the method, not statistical significance. Three simulated or live reviewers and one repository are enough to show the measurement, and they are not enough to estimate a population rate.
